noNodesHint: Run the install command on a VPS and its card will appear here.
managedTunnelDescription: Creates a stable hostname, Tunnel, and DNS. No public URL to enter.
quickTunnelDescription: Gets a temporary trycloudflare.com URL automatically; best for demos and tests.
managedTunnelWait: This creates a dedicated Tunnel, DNS record, and stable hostname. The install command appears here after it succeeds.
installCommandPending: Create the stable Tunnel first; the install command appears after it succeeds.
managedTunnelNeedsSetup: Set up the Managed Tunnel OAuth client for this control plane first.
managedTunnelSetupDescription: The one-time bootstrap uses an API Token to create a scoped private OAuth client, then discards the Token.
managedTunnelSetupStep1: Create an API Token with Account: OAuth Client / Write, Workers Scripts / Edit, and D1 / Edit.
managedTunnelSetupStep2: Run the command below; it automatically creates the private OAuth client and stores only its Client ID and secret.
managedTunnelSetupStep3: Return here to connect Cloudflare; the account is loaded automatically and you select from its available domains.
managedTunnelSetupSecurityHint: The high-privilege Token is used only by the local bootstrap and is not stored in the Worker, browser, or VPS.
cloudflareSelectZoneHint: The Zone ID is saved automatically with the selected domain; no manual entry is needed.
cloudflareConnectHint: Your browser opens Cloudflare authorization. The account ID was saved during bootstrap; no personal API token is requested or stored.
cloudflareConnectedHint: Tunnels and DNS records will be created in this account and domain.
cloudflareAuthorizationFailed: Cloudflare authorization did not complete. Try again.
quickTunnelNotice: The URL may change after cloudflared reconnects; the Agent re-registers automatically.
redisUrlHint: Prefer rediss://. Use redis:// only when Redis is on a private or restricted network.
registrationSecretHint: The same secret stored in the Cloudflare Worker. It only authorizes agent registration and is never saved by this page.
allowApt: Allow agent to install apt packages
allowAptHint: Package maintainer scripts may run as root. Enable only when needed.
confirmRemove: Remove this node? This will not uninstall the agent on the VPS.
rejectPrompt: Optional: add a rejection reason. The next registration request will return to pending.
autoId: The installer generates a random node ID automatically.
setupTunnel: Choose a connection mode to generate a ready-to-run command.
noTask: Tasks are submitted through MCP or schedules.
footer: VPS Agent · Cloudflare Worker + D1 + BullMQ
